automation_state.description: Internal per-save Storage Auto Pause automation state. Do not edit manually.

diagnostic_semaphore_enabled.description: Enable the two lower status lights (electricity and workers). Logistics light remains active regardless.

breakdown_fireworks_enabled.description: Launch a warning flare when a maintained building transitions into the broken state.

breakdown_fireworks_sound_enabled.description: Enable spatial launch/explosion audio for breakdown fireworks.
